name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: International standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Provides requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an ISMS.

controls.title: Understanding the organization and its context
controls.description: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcome(s) of its ISMS.

controls.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
controls.description: The organization shall determine interested parties relevant to the ISMS, their requirements, and which requirements will be addressed through the ISMS.

controls.title: Determining the scope of the ISMS
controls.description: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the ISMS to establish its scope.

controls.title: Leadership and commitment
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the ISMS.

controls.title: Information security policy
controls.description: Top management shall establish an information security policy that is appropriate to the purpose of the organization.

controls.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
controls.description: Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for roles relevant to information security are assigned and communicated.

controls.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities — General
controls.description: When planning for the ISMS, the organization shall consider the issues referred to in 4.1 and the requirements referred to in 4.2.

controls.title: Information security risk assessment
controls.description: The organization shall define and apply an information security risk assessment process.

controls.title: Information security risk treatment
controls.description: The organization shall define and apply an information security risk treatment process.

controls.title: Information security objectives and planning to achieve them
controls.description: The organization shall establish information security objectives at relevant functions and levels.

controls.title: Resources
controls.description: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the ISMS.

controls.title: Competence
controls.description: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of persons doing work under its control that affects its information security performance.

controls.title: Awareness
controls.description: Persons doing work under the organization's control shall be aware of the information security policy, their contribution to the ISMS, and implications of not conforming.

controls.title: Documented information
controls.description: The organization's ISMS shall include documented information required by this document and documented information determined as necessary.

controls.title: Operational planning and control
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement, control, monitor and review the processes needed to meet requirements for the provision of products and services.

controls.title: Information security risk assessment
controls.description: The organization shall perform information security risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed or occur.

controls.title: Information security risk treatment
controls.description: The organization shall implement the information security risk treatment plan.

controls.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
controls.description: The organization shall evaluate the information security performance and the effectiveness of the ISMS.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.description: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the ISMS conforms to requirements.

controls.title: Management review
controls.description: Top management shall review the organization's ISMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

controls.title: Continual improvement
controls.description: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the ISMS.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates shall be carried out prior to joining the organization.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: All personnel and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate awareness education and training.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated and appropriate measures taken.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
